name: Q12: ETL Pipeline Health
sql:
SELECT
    batch_id,
    status,
    started_at,
    ended_at,
    ROUND(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (ended_at - started_at)), 1) AS duration_sec,
    rows_extracted,
    rows_loaded,
    rows_rejected,
    error_summary
FROM metadata.etl_runs
ORDER BY started_at DESC
LIMIT 20
